async()=>{OvuWalk.travel('harbour'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2800)); OvuHarbour.sitDown(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500));}
async()=>{OvuWalk.travel('street'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2800)); OvuSeats.begin('street'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,900));}
